info.title: Rento Vroom API
info.description: REST API for the Rento Vroom website and future apps. Every error response is `{ error: { code, message, fields? } }`. Requests that change data from a browser must come from the website's own origin.

cookieAuth.name: rv_access
cookieAuth.description: The 15-minute access token, set by the sign-in routes (the website)

bearerAuth.description: The same access token in an Authorization header (mobile apps)

mfaEnabled.description: Staff: whether two-factor sign-in is on

pendingAgreements.description: Legal documents with a new version the user must accept before carrying on (POST /me/agreements). Usually empty.

message.description: A message that can be shown to the user

fields.description: One message per invalid input field

challenge.description: Send back with the code to POST /auth/login/mfa (5 minutes)

sent.description: false when the email address is already confirmed
false when it is already the verified number

maxDevices.description: How many authenticator apps an account can have

lastUsedAt.description: The last time one of its codes was used

secret.description: For typing into the app by hand

qrCode.description: The otpauth URL as a PNG data: URL

clientSecret.description: Lets Stripe.js on the page confirm this one payment. Never logged or stored.

status.description: The PaymentIntent status: succeeded, processing, requires_payment_method, requires_action, canceled, …

type.description: The payment method type, e.g. card or link

wallet.description: apple_pay or google_pay when a card was paid through a wallet

paymentMethod.description: Null until the payment has been attempted

webhookReceived.description: Whether Stripe’s payment_intent.succeeded event reached the webhook

date.description: The day the rates are for; the ECB publishes on European working days

rates.description: How much of each currency NZ$1 buys

place.description: The place searched; null for all of NZ

placeNotFound.description: The typed place matched nothing, so the results cover all of NZ

distanceKm.description: From the searched place; null without one

totalCents.description: Every mandatory charge for the dates (rental, service fee, mandatory protection, GST), plus airport delivery for an airport search

estimate.description: Only when the search has dates

Rating.description: Average stars and how many reviews; count 0 shows as "New"

id.description: `place:<id>` for our places, `google:<placeId>` for a street address

label.description: What to show and put in the field, e.g. "Auckland Airport (AKL)"

secondary.description: The city or region under the name

lat.description: Our places include coordinates; addresses need GET /places/{id}

id.description: `place:<id>` for our places, `google:<placeId>` for a street address

label.description: What to show and put in the field, e.g. "Auckland Airport (AKL)"

secondary.description: The city or region under the name

address.description: A street address in the structured NZ format, when every part is known

approx.description: A circle that contains the car, for the map; never its address

kind.description: A Warrant of Fitness, or a Certificate of Fitness

required.description: Diesel, EV and plug-in hybrid cars pay Road User Charges

radiusKm.description: DELIVERY: how far from the car it delivers

area.description: PICKUP and CUSTOM: the suburb and city only

busy.description: When the car is taken, merged; never why

available.description: False when there are problems; the price is still shown

start.description: "2026-10-12T10:00" in NZ time, or ISO 8601 with an offset

pickupOptionId.description: Left out: collect from the Host

returnOptionId.description: Left out: the same as pick-up

airports.description: IATA codes of the airports that serve it
IATA codes of the airports that serve it

show.description: False until the published reviews reach the homepage threshold in settings: hide the section

ref.description: The support ticket reference, e.g. ST-4HX8PA

post.summary: Create a Guest account
post.description: Records acceptance of the current Terms and Privacy Policy, emails a link to confirm the address, and signs the new user in (sets the auth cookies). Passwords need 10+ characters, not a common one and not the email name. Rate-limited per IP.

400.description: Invalid input. `error.fields` has one message per invalid field.

409.description: Conflicts with existing data, e.g. the email address already has an account

429.description: Too many requests; try again later

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Sets the httpOnly auth cookies. Staff with an authenticator app get `mfaRequired` and a challenge instead, for POST /auth/login/mfa. `portal: "admin"` refuses accounts without a staff role. Rate-limited per IP, and sign-in locks for 15 minutes after 5 wrong passwords.

200.description: Signed in, or the authenticator code is needed next

400.description: Invalid input. `error.fields` has one message per invalid field.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: Signed in, but this account can't do this (or the request came from an untrusted origin)

423.description: Sign-in is paused after too many wrong passwords

429.description: Too many requests; try again later

post.summary: Finish a staff sign-in with the authenticator code
post.description: The challenge from POST /auth/login and the 6-digit code from the app. Each code works once. After 5 wrong codes, or 5 minutes, the challenge expires (401 MFA_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED) and the password is needed again.

400.description: Invalid input. `error.fields` has one message per invalid field.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

429.description: Too many requests; try again later

post.summary: Who is signed in on this browser
post.description: The website's check on page load. Always 200: `user` is null for a visitor. Renews an expired access token with the refresh cookie in the same call.

post.summary: Renew the session
post.description: Swaps the refresh cookie for a new pair of cookies. Each refresh token works once.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

post.summary: Sign out
post.description: Ends the session and clears the auth cookies.

post.summary: Confirm an email address
post.description: The token from the link in the confirmation email. Each link works once and expires after 24 hours. Works signed out.

400.description: Invalid input. `error.fields` has one message per invalid field.

429.description: Too many requests; try again later

post.summary: Send a new confirmation link
post.description: The previous link stops working. Up to 5 an hour per user.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

429.description: Too many requests; try again later

post.summary: Email a link to choose a new password
post.description: Sent only if the address has an account, but the answer is the same either way, so it can’t be used to find out who has one. The link works once and expires after 1 hour.

400.description: Invalid input. `error.fields` has one message per invalid field.

429.description: Too many requests; try again later

post.summary: Choose a new password from the emailed link
post.description: Signs the account out on every device and emails "Password changed". The link also confirms the email address. It does not sign in.

400.description: Invalid input. `error.fields` has one message per invalid field.

429.description: Too many requests; try again later

post.summary: Text a verification code to a mobile number
post.description: NZ numbers work without +64; overseas numbers need their country code. Landlines are refused. The number replaces the verified one only once its code is checked. 409 PHONE_TAKEN if another account verified it.

get.summary: Staff: two-factor sign-in and its authenticator apps
get.description: Two-factor sign-in is optional for staff, and each staff member can have up to two authenticator apps (a backup for a lost phone). Never includes the secrets.

200.description: Whether it is on, and the apps

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: Signed in, but this account can't do this (or the request came from an untrusted origin)

post.summary: Staff: start adding an authenticator app
post.description: A new secret, shown once as a QR code, for the first app or a backup. Finish with POST /me/mfa/verify. 409 MFA_DEVICE_LIMIT when there are already two.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: Signed in, but this account can't do this (or the request came from an untrusted origin)

409.description: Conflicts with existing data, e.g. the email address already has an account

post.summary: Staff: finish adding an authenticator app
post.description: The first code from the new app, which proves it has the secret. The first app turns two-factor sign-in on and signs out every other device (this one stays signed in). A second app also needs `currentCode`, from the app already set up. Emails the staff member either way.

name.description: What to call the app, e.g. "Work phone". A default is used when empty.

currentCode.description: Needed when two-factor sign-in is already on: a code from an app already set up
